scenes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one inline landscape illustration for Kanji Trail Beauty and the Beast, after paragraph 0. Show an older French merchant in a plain indigo travelling cloak and muted terracotta scarf, walking through a snowy forest toward the warmly lit open doorway of a large stone castle. He has grey hair and a simple small face, natural proportions. Quiet hopeful evening mood, broad snow shapes, only three depth layers. Gentle painted picture-book style: broad smooth colour areas, soft contours, minimal texture and detail, a few purposeful shadows; warm ivory snow, midnight indigo trees, sage stone and ochre doorway light. Full bleed wide 12:7 landscape. The castle and merchant are clear at small inline size. Depict only this opening arrival; no Beast, Belle, rose, magical objects, future events, film costumes, text, signage, lettering, borders or watermark. Avoid rich cover texture, photorealism and busy background.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story painting for Kanji Trail’s original retelling of the traditional French fairy tale Beauty and the Beast
Primary request: depict the end of paragraph 1, when the young woman from Image 4 has arrived at the castle and is given a splendid room.
Input images: Images 1–3 are approved Kasa Jizō inline paintings; use them only for their simple broad-shape illustration treatment. Image 4 is the project’s original cover; use it only for the young woman’s character identity and palette, not its detailed castle rendering.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet, spacious castle guest room with a tall window overlooking a snowy French countryside. Keep the room simple and calm.
Subject: the young woman from Image 4 stands near the window and takes in the room, wearing her familiar muted golden dress and simple dark hair ribbon. Her face has natural proportions and minimal features.
Style/medium: simple children’s picture-book painting in the Kasa Jizō inline treatment, broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, and much simpler detail than a cover.
Composition/framing: wide landscape about 12:7, one clear focal subject, two or three quiet depth layers, readable at small inline size.
Lighting/mood: soft winter daylight with gentle warmth from the interior, reflective and reassuring.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted gold, sage, midnight indigo, and restrained cool snow tones drawn from the cover palette.
Constraints: preserve the traditional French fairy-tale castle context. Show only the arrival and splendid room described by paragraph 1. No Beast, no events from later paragraphs, no film-adaptation likeness or costume, no lettering, title, labels, borders, frame, or watermark.
Avoid: photorealism, glossy 3D, rich cover texture, dense brushwork, busy décor, ominous shadows, clutter, text.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story painting for Kanji Trail’s original retelling of the traditional French fairy tale Beauty and the Beast
Primary request: show the end of paragraph 2, when Belle reads aloud to the Beast and he listens quietly.
Input images: Images 1–3 are approved Kasa Jizō inline paintings; use them only for their simple broad-shape illustration treatment. Image 4 is the project’s original cover; use it only for the young woman’s identity and palette, not as a detail target.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet castle library with a short, simple bookshelf, a tall window and a glimpse of the garden; keep the background spare.
Subject: the young woman from Image 4, in her familiar muted golden dress and simple dark hair ribbon, sits with an open old story and reads aloud. Across a small table, the castle’s master listens: an original, large animal-like Beast with soft muted brown fur, a broad but gentle face, small rounded ears and calm eyes. He looks attentive rather than threatening. Keep both faces natural and understated.
Style/medium: simple children’s picture-book painting in the Kasa Jizō inline treatment, broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, far simpler than cover art.
Composition/framing: wide landscape about 12:7; show Belle, the Beast and the open book clearly as one calm scene, with two or three quiet depth layers and readable silhouettes at small inline size.
Lighting/mood: warm late-afternoon light, tentative trust and quiet companionship.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted gold, sage, midnight indigo and gentle brown, consistent with the cover palette.
Constraints: preserve the traditional French fairy-tale castle setting. Keep the Beast’s design original to this retelling, not based on any film character, actor, costume or franchise. Show only the reading scene described by paragraph 2. No transformation, prince, rose magic, later events, visible words, lettering, labels, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: photorealism, glossy 3D, rich cover texture, dense brushwork, ornate décor, ominous shadows, clutter, text.
